title: Tech Note: UDDI Client as a SOAP Example (API inquiry)

historical_commentary.text: UDDI as a technology has been effectively abandoned industry-wide — the public UDDI Business Registry was shut down years ago, and modern service discovery uses very different mechanisms (API gateways, service meshes, OpenAPI directories) — making this note's core subject matter obsolete, though the underlying idea of discoverable service registries persists in different modern forms.
